# The Apple of Discord: Volume 14 Mythology by Litera

Dive into the rich world of ancient Greek myths with this captivating volume, focusing on one of history's most famous incidents: **The Apple of Discord**. Published as part of the comprehensive mythology series from Litera, this book provides a detailed and engaging look at how divine conflict shapes mortal history.

This Volume 14 explores the powerful narrative threads that connect gods to everyday life in ancient Greece. It guides young readers through the complexities of fate, rivalry, and destiny, centered around the pivotal figure of Eris.

## Understanding Eris and the Apple of Discord

In Greek mythology, almost every aspect of daily life was attributed to a specific deity. Among these powerful beings was Erisâthe Goddess of Discord and Chaos. The narrative within this volume recounts how Eris's immense frustration led her to instigate conflict unlike any seen before: the legendary Trojan War.

The catalyst for this monumental conflict was the titular artifact: a beautiful, golden apple. This single item became known forever as the **Apple of Discord**, sparking rivalries among the greatest figures of the age and setting humanity on a path toward epic war.

### What Readers Will Discover

This educational volume is designed to make complex mythological narratives accessible and exciting for young minds. Within its pages, readers will learn:

*   **The Role of Eris:** Understanding the motivations behind discord and chaos in ancient belief systems.
*   **Mythological Conflict:** Following a detailed account of how one item can trigger world-altering events.
*   **Greek Cosmology:** Gaining foundational knowledge about various Greek deities and their influence on human civilization, making it an ideal companion for students studying classical history or literature.

---

**Brand:** Litera

Explore the depth of Greek mythology and bring the epic stories to life with this essential volume on the Apple of Discord. [Purchase your copy here](https://event.2performant.com/events/click?ad_type=product_store&unique=f6388057d&aff_code=bf1d69700&campaign_unique=0a8a2c4d9).

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book appropriate for all ages?**
A: This volume is designed for young readers interested in detailed historical and mythological narratives. While it covers complex themes like conflict, the presentation makes the stories engaging and educational for children who enjoy mythology.
